donate.hero.title: Support Us
donate.hero.subtitle: Your generosity empowers Afghan women and girls through media, education, and storytelling.
donate.impact.title: Why Your Support Matters
donate.impact.body1: Every contribution, no matter the size, directly supports our mission to amplify women's voices. Your donation helps us provide training, create safe spaces for storytelling, and produce independent journalism.
donate.impact.body2: We believe in transparency. Funds are used responsibly to cover operational costs, educational materials, and supporting the women who share their stories with the world.
donate.how.title: Make a Donation
donate.how.body: For your security and convenience, we use HesabPay to process donations. Click the button below to donate securely.
donate.note: Opens the HesabPay application securely in a new tab.
